parts.text: Radio coverage was patchy in bad weather and around industrial sites, meaning reports from drones arrived late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Drones sometimes restarted in flight after a software fault and carried on, while closures were amended during the day and could even come into force while drones from several companies were already in the air. Batteries also drained faster in cold and wind than planned, and the server was updated and restarted during working hours while drones were flying, occasionally crashing.
